label: misread
evidence: Learn more – how Google uses data from partners’ sites or apps
We will not share your current location with partners.
reason: Statement 1 is a link describing Google's own data practices. It does not permit the policy owner to share location with partners.

label: allow
evidence: Typically, we do not collect Personal Data through your use of the Online Services.
device manufacturer and model, language
reason: Statement 2 is hedged by 'Typically' and followed by 'However, we may collect Other Data', which includes language and is treated as Personal Data when it relates to an individual, so collection is permitted.

label: different_practice
evidence: may disclose it to any member of our group
we do not retain data in a form that permits identification of the person(s) to whom it relates for any longer than is necessary
reason: Statement 1 permits disclosure to group members and suppliers. Statement 2 limits how long identifiable data is retained. Disclosure and retention are different practices.

label: different_practice
evidence: TED may use the information to understand its members and to provide information about membership benefits.
TED will use the data solely for research purposes
reason: Statement 1 concerns member and subscriber information. Statement 2 restricts data collected through research surveys and questionnaires. The statements govern different data.

label: misread
evidence: The list of apps is scanned offline - we do not share or collect this information.
We do not collect any information about our users.
reason: Statement 1 says the app list is scanned on the device and is neither collected nor shared, so it does not permit collection. Both statements deny collection.

label: deny
evidence: We collect, use, and share your personal data where we are satisfied that we have an appropriate legal basis to do this.
We do not intentionally collect personal data from, and do not tailor any services to, children.
reason: Statement 2 carves children out of the general collection and disclosure in statement 1. For a child's data, the policy says it does not intentionally collect it.

label: allow
evidence: We may disclose Personal Data to your agent or legal representative
We do not sell or rent your Personal Data to third parties.
reason: Statement 2 prohibits only sale or rental. Disclosure to the user's own agent or legal representative is not a sale or rental, so the disclosure is permitted.

label: misread
evidence: Depending on the circumstances, you have a right to know:
whether we sell your personal information to third parties;
reason: Statement 1 lists an item the user has a right to know about. It does not permit selling personal information.

label: contradiction
evidence: such as IP address, geolocation information, unique device identifiers
never collect data from your device
reason: The Device data section says TED may collect geolocation and device identifiers about the device used. Statement 2 says TED never collects data from the device. Nothing says which governs.

label: allow
evidence: Subsplash will only utilize that information for purposes of providing the Service
for materially different, unrelated, or incompatible purposes without providing you notice
reason: Statement 1 permits use of contacted persons' information only to provide the Service. Statement 2 prohibits only materially different or incompatible purposes without notice, which excludes this use.

label: unresolved
evidence: We may collect your information when you communicate with us or you give us.
DVloper (DVapps AB) do not collect Personal Information.
reason: Communicating with the company can supply data such as an email address, which the policy defines as Personal Information. The vague 'your information' leaves unclear which statement governs.

label: unresolved
evidence: Typically, we do not collect Personal Data through your use of the Online Services.
details of your special anniversaries (such as your birthday or wedding anniversary)
reason: Statement 1 does not say through which channel important dates are collected. If they are collected through the Online Services, the hedged 'Typically' in statement 2 does not settle whether collection happens.

label: misread
evidence: if it takes place, will be processed by us
We do not collect any personal data from children with our Services.
reason: Statement 1 describes the scope of the policy for personal data processing 'if it takes place'. It does not itself permit collecting or processing data.

label: contradiction
evidence: We may also share anonymized data, such as statistical or demographic information in aggregate form, with third parties
We do not sell or disclose deidentified Personal Information to third parties.
reason: Statement 1 permits sharing anonymized aggregate data with third parties. Statement 2 says deidentified information is never disclosed to third parties. Nothing in the text says which governs.

label: different_practice
evidence: Amwell uses third party vendors and service-providers that help us provide you the Services.
We allow third parties, including business partners, advertising networks, and other advertising service providers
reason: Statement 2 restricts vendors that help provide the Services. Statement 1 concerns advertising partners collecting data for interest-based ads. The text treats them as different parties.

label: deny
evidence: We may share internet usage information with ad networks and other advertising partners
nor do we knowingly sell or share personal information of children under the age of 16.
reason: Statement 2 carves children under 16 out of the general sharing and disclosure in statement 1. For a known child's data, the policy prohibits selling or sharing.

label: misread
evidence: This policy does not apply to information collected by third party social networks
we expressly disclaim any responsibility for the data collection, privacy or data security practices of those entities
reason: Statement 2 limits the policy's scope and disclaims responsibility for third parties' collection. It prohibits no practice of the company.

label: unresolved
evidence: To provide troubleshooting and customer support, we may need to access your information, such as your account email address.
On the server, your data is protected and not viewed or analyzed in any way.
reason: Support access to stored user data falls under both statements. The general 'your information' may or may not include the synced content in statement 2, and the text does not say which governs.

label: different_practice
evidence: If you choose to create an account or log into account via a third party such as Facebook or Google
In some cases, our Apps provide you with ability to indicate some personal data of your child
reason: Statement 1 concerns account data received from Facebook or Google. Statement 2 concerns a child's data entered in the app and kept on the device. The data differ.

label: different_practice
evidence: When you use these apps your device automatically sends certain information to our advertising partners.
We do not collect any personal information about the users of our apps.
reason: Statement 1 describes advertising partners such as AdMob collecting device identifiers. Statement 2 concerns collection by the developer itself. The collecting parties differ.
